name: Garran Vale
title: The Last Watch
speciality: Holding the line, protecting companions and turning a completely defended enemy action into a decisive counterattack.

specialPowers.name: Riposte
specialPowers.description: When an enemy action is completely defended and the enemy remains alive, counterattack for 4 plus current plating damage. This retaliation bypasses enemy shield protection.
specialPowers.visualDirection: A compact, precise sword counter following a planted shield guard. Communicate discipline and weight; no permanent magical aura.

weapons.name: Watchman's arming sword
weapons.relationship: Signature visual equipment; not a separate implemented inventory item.
weapons.description: A straight double-edged steel blade, simple antique-brass crossguard, dark leather grip and small pommel. Grip sits between guard and pommel. Nominal total length is 128 source pixels at the 256-pixel body target.

weapons.name: Scarlet kite shield
weapons.relationship: Signature visual equipment; actual protection is determined by equipped inventory items.
weapons.description: A tall tapering red shield with steel edging and a simple pale four-point emblem; worn finish in broad material clusters, supported by a hand grip and forearm straps.

itemAliasNotes: The legacy longsword item ID is currently displayed as Iron Dagger. Garran's illustrated arming sword is costume equipment, not a promise about his starting item.

bio.summary: A former bridge-watch captain who keeps counting the people behind him, even when he travels alone.
bio.origin: Garran spent most of his adult life guarding a river crossing used by merchants and displaced families. When the watch was ordered to close the gates during an evacuation, he stayed outside with the final wagon. He survived; his command did not. He now takes dungeon contracts to buy safe passage and supplies for settlements that cannot pay for protection.
personality: Careful with equipment and generous with food
bio.motivation: Find the missing members of his watch and earn a future in which nobody is left outside a locked gate.
bio.mannerisms: Checks shield straps before answering a difficult question; quietly moves himself between danger and the least experienced person in the room.
bio.voice: Short, practical sentences with a calm, reassuring delivery.
bio.quote: Behind me. We can argue when everyone is home.

physicalAppearance.build: Broad-shouldered, muscular and work-hardened, with a substantial chest, compact waist and strong legs. Armor follows believable joints rather than inflating the shoulders or boots.
physicalAppearance.silhouette: A tall, grounded steel knight: narrow closed helmet, swept scarlet crest, substantial articulated shoulders, tapering shield on the viewer's right and lowered sword on the viewer's left.
physicalAppearance.headTreatment: Fully closed steel helmet. The visor is intentionally dark; do not add a visible human face or two glowing eyes.
physicalAppearance.headShape: Angular enclosed helm with a pronounced central brow ridge, narrow dark eye slit and long vertical faceplate opening. The helmet remains integrated with the neck and shoulders.
physicalAppearance.face: Concealed in the standard design. For a separately requested unhelmeted variant only: square jaw, warm tan skin, hazel eyes and a short scar beneath the left side of the chin.
physicalAppearance.hair: Concealed. Unhelmeted identity only: short dark-brown hair graying at the temples; never show it through the visor.
physicalAppearance.headwear: Scarlet crest sweeping backward from the helmet crown; use broad connected red clusters and preserve its complete silhouette in portraits.
physicalAppearance.upperBody: Cool steel breastplate with clear planar highlights, layered rounded pauldrons, articulated forearm plates and dark mail visible at the joints. Brown leather harness and a small brass cloak clasp.
physicalAppearance.lowerBody: Layered steel hip plates over dark mail, fitted brown belt with brass buckle, red hanging cloth between the legs, articulated knee guards and practical steel sabatons.
physicalAppearance.hands: Fully enclosed steel gauntlets. Sword fingers visibly close around the hilt; shield arm supports the shield's weight through a coherent forearm position.
physicalAppearance.cloak: Deep scarlet cloak attached at the shoulders, falling behind the body with a broad asymmetric drape and a lightly weathered hem.
distinguishingFeatures: Closed angular steel helm with backward red crest
Scarlet shoulder cloak and matching shield
A planted, reassuring stance rather than an aggressive lunge
physicalAppearance.expressionAndBearing: The face remains concealed; confidence comes from the helmet angle, relaxed shoulders and controlled equipment placement.
physicalAppearance.effects: None in the default idle design.
physicalAppearance.portraitDirection: Center the helmet and crest as the identity, preserve the entire crest and lower faceplate, and include a small amount of scarlet collar and steel shoulder. Exclude sword and shield; repair any overlaps from the concept.
avoid: A hand merely touching the sword edge
A permanent fire or cyan aura

identityStatus: Newly authored character profile; names and lore have not yet been individually reviewed.

body.measurement: Head/headwear to soles; exclude held equipment, detached effects and transparent padding.

portrait.source: Original generated concept or another sufficiently detailed identity source, independently framed and cleaned.
portrait.framing: Optically center the visible head; preserve complete hair/headwear and chin, with modest neck and shoulder context.
portrait.obstructions: Remove incidental weapons, quivers, spell fragments and other obstructions; reconstruct hidden head details. Retain intentional helmets and masks.

generation.pose: Upright, relaxed and alert, slight three-quarter turn toward the viewer's right, grounded feet and a natural weight shift.
generation.rendering: Original fantasy pixel art with cohesive adult proportions, deliberate connected clusters, sculpted material planes, selective highlights and restrained texture. Exposed faces use intentional anime-inspired eye/lid, nose and mouth shapes.
deliverables: Separate 64 x 64 portrait spritex authoring JSON
generation.review: Inspect body, grip and portrait at native/intended display size. Technical validation is separate from user approval.
